pages.title: The Wither
pages.text: The Wither is too powerful to be bound at the height of its vitality. You must wait until it starts getting desperate (has less than half its health) before you will be able to bind it. This almost always requires Claim Arrows (see the Ruins book).

pages.title: The Ender Dragon
pages.text: You can force the Ender Dragon's egg to hatch by influencing it with 8 end crystals in block foci. If the egg is in a valid dragon binding, it will hatch into a bound dragon.
